log_file.description: Absolute path to the log file for the notification agent.

verbose.description: Enable or disable verbose logging (includes request/response details).

workers.description: Number of worker processes to handle incoming notifications. Increase for higher throughput.

transport_url.description: Message bus transport URL (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka) used to consume OpenStack notifications.

sources.description: List of notification sources (handlers) to enable. Each item corresponds to a Ceilometer source configuration block.

topics.description: List of AMQP notification topics to subscribe to (e.g., 'notifications' for all, or specific severity levels).

rate_limit.description: Maximum events per second per worker to rate-limit (0 = unlimited).

batch_size.description: Maximum number of events to batch before writing to storage.

storage_url.description: Backend storage URL for event data (MongoDB, SQLAlchemy, etc.).

enable_ttl.description: Enable automatic expiration of old event data (requires backend support).

time_to_live.description: Time (in seconds) after which events are automatically deleted (if TTL enabled). Default: 14 days.

keystone_project_domain.description: Keystone domain name for the project.

keystone_project_name.description: Keystone service project name (where Ceilometer runs).

keystone_user_domain.description: Keystone domain name for the service user.

keystone_username.description: Service username for Ceilometer in Keystone.

keystone_password.description: Password for the Ceilometer service user in Keystone.
